section_1_contracts.notes: ImmuneFrame, availability model, confidence, evidence/prediction record slots, contribution ledger, runtime issue model, registry framework, version metadata, deterministic serialization all implemented and used. buildImmuneFrame is the single canonical top-level frame builder.

section_2_shared.notes: Aggregation + confidence + double-counting guard ARE reused by Section 4. State-machine GUARD (immuneStateMachines) reused. The stateful transition CONTROLLER (immuneTransitions.ImmuneStateController) and the evidence/prediction record FRAMEWORK (immuneEvidencePrediction) are IMPLEMENTED but NOT used by any production engine.

section_3_innate.notes: No innate biology runtime module exists (no macrophage/NK/DC/antigen-presentation/innate-integration runtime). Only Section-1 UNAVAILABLE carriers + structure-only registries. innate-immunity/antigen-presentation registries define structure but no engine computes them.

section_4_adaptive.notes: CD8/CD4/Treg/checkpoint(PD1/PDL1/axis/CTLA4)/suppression/escape/adaptive-integration/net-integration all implemented, run in acyclic order via immuneAdaptiveEngine, publish immutable frames via buildImmuneFrame, availability+confidence aware, ledger + double-counting participation. Does NOT emit transition records.

part2_section1_renderer.notes: Renderer, inspector, timeline, replay, views, debugger, search, export, serialization validation all operational + read-only. Consumes both Section-1 and Section-4 frame shapes via a spec table with fallbacks.

phase8a_integration.notes: immuneResistanceAdapter.buildImmuneResistanceContext (S1) + buildExtendedImmuneResistanceContext (S4). Reports available=false when biology unavailable -> Phase 8A fallback preserved. Phase 8A non-immune logic unchanged (resistanceEngine.js untouched; production diff empty).
